A task-oriented reader for the verified registry graph. It starts with cited relationships rather than a force-laid-out network; position carries no meaning, and unresolved names remain research leads rather than principals.

Reading rules. “Cited” means this specific graph edge has an originating source ID. “Current” and “historical” require a directly cited, dated registry-history entry. “Undated” does not establish when a relationship applied. An evidence gap means the edge lacks an originating source ID; it is not evidence that no source exists.
